title: Xanthe and the Silence
author: Paloma Thackeray
blurb: Edmund Marchetti, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, has spent seven years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
